sentences.text: Learning is the process of acquiring new understanding, knowledge, behavior, skills, values, attitudes, and preferences.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: the process of acquiring new understanding, knowledge, behavior, skills, values, attitudes, and preferences

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Learning is the process。of acquiring ... 说明过程的内容，acquiring 是介词 of 后的动名词；后面从 understanding 到 preferences 的并列名词列出学习能获得的内容。

sentences.text: The ability to learn is possessed by humans, other animals, and some machines.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主语是 The ability to learn，to learn 修饰 ability。is possessed by 是被动结构；by 后并列 humans、other animals 和 some machines，说明哪些主体拥有这种能力，some 限定 machines。

sentences.text: There is also evidence for some kind of learning in certain plants.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: evidence for some kind of learning in certain plants

sentences.readingHintZh: 这是 There is ... 存在句，实际陈述存在的是 evidence。for 后说明证据支持的内容；some kind of learning 和 certain plants 都有限定范围，不能扩展为所有植物都能以相同方式学习。

sentences.text: Some learning is immediate, induced by a single event (e.g. being burned by a hot stove), but much skill and knowledge accumulate from repeated experiences.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: induced by a single event (e.g. being burned by a hot stove)

sentences.readingHintZh: but 连接两个完整分句：Some learning is immediate 与 much skill and knowledge accumulate ...。induced by a single event 是过去分词补充说明，括号举例；前后的 single 与 repeated 构成关键对照。

sentences.text: The changes induced by learning often last a lifetime, and it is hard to distinguish learned material that seems to be "lost" from that which cannot be retrieved.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: to distinguish learned material that seems to be "lost" from that which cannot be retrieved

sentences.readingHintZh: 第一分句主干 The changes ... often last a lifetime；induced by learning 修饰 changes，often 修饰 last。第二分句用 it 作形式主语，to distinguish A from B 是真正主语；A 是看似丢失的内容，B 是无法提取的内容，两者各有定语从句。

sentences.text: Human learning begins at birth and may even start before birth and continues until death as a consequence of ongoing interactions between people and their environment.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: Human learning 是三个并列谓语 begins、may start 和 continues 的共同主语。at birth、before birth、until death 分别标示时间；as a consequence of 表示持续互动所产生的结果，between ... and ... 连接互动双方。

sentences.text: The nature and processes involved in learning are studied in many established fields (including educational psychology, neuropsychology, experimental psychology, Cognitive science, and pedagogy), as well as emerging fields of knowledge (e.g. with a shared interest in the topic of learning from safety events such as incidents or accidents, or in collaborative learning health systems).
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subjects.text: The nature and processes involved in learning

sentences.readingHintZh: 主语中心是 nature and processes，involved in learning 为过去分词修饰语；are studied 是被动谓语。先跳过两个长括号，读出研究发生于 established fields 以及 emerging fields；as well as 连接这两类领域。

sentences.text: Research in such fields has led to the significant identification of various sorts of learning.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Research ... has led to the ... identification。lead to 表示“促成”，to 是介词；of various sorts of learning 说明识别的对象。such fields 回指前句列出的研究领域。

sentences.text: For example, learning may occur as a result of habituation, or classical conditioning, operant conditioning or as a result of more complex activities such as play, seen only in more cognitively complex animals.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 learning may occur。两个 as a result of 短语列出学习产生的不同途径；such as play 为 more complex activities 举例，seen only ... 是过去分词补充说明，限定的是这类活动的出现范围。

sentences.text: Learning may occur consciously or without conscious awareness.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: Learning 是主语，may occur 是谓语，may 表示可能。or 连接 consciously 与 without conscious awareness 两种方式状语；它们虽然形式不同，但在句中作用相同。

existingAnnotation.text: Learning may occur consciously or without conscious awareness.
existingAnnotation.translation: 学习可能有意识地发生，也可能在人没有意识到的情况下发生。
existingAnnotation.analysis: Learning是主语，may occur是情态动词加动词构成的谓语；consciously与without conscious awareness由or连接，作为两种方式状语形成对比。
existingAnnotation.label: 原有整句译文与讲解（AI 编写）

sourceSpan.text: Learning may occur consciously or without conscious awareness.

sentences.text: Learning that an aversive event cannot be avoided or escaped may result in a condition called learned helplessness.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subjects.text: Learning that an aversive event cannot be avoided or escaped

subordinateClauses.text: that an aversive event cannot be avoided or escaped

sentences.readingHintZh: 整个 Learning that ... 动名词结构作主语，that 从句说明学到的内容。主句谓语是 may result in；called learned helplessness 是过去分词短语，修饰 condition，不能把 called 当成另一个主句谓语。

sentences.text: There is evidence for human behavioral learning prenatally, in which habituation has been observed as early as 32 weeks into gestation, indicating that the central nervous system is sufficiently developed and primed for learning and memory to occur very early on in development.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

relativeClauses.text: in which habituation has been observed as early as 32 weeks into gestation

subordinateClauses.text: indicating that the central nervous system is sufficiently developed and primed for learning and memory to occur very early on in development
that the central nervous system is sufficiently developed and primed for learning and memory to occur very early on in development
for learning and memory to occur very early on in development

sentences.readingHintZh: 先抓 There is evidence for ...。in which 引导补充产前学习情形的定语从句，has been observed 是现在完成时被动结构；indicating 后的 that 从句说明这一观察所提示的结果。for learning and memory to occur 中，learning and memory 是不定式的逻辑主语。

sentences.text: Play has been approached by several theorists as a form of learning.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: Play 是被动句主语，has been approached 是现在完成时被动谓语。by several theorists 指持此研究观点的人；as a form of learning 说明他们把游戏作为何种现象来研究，approached 在此不是空间上的“接近”。

sentences.text: Children experiment with the world, learn the rules, and learn to interact through play.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: Children 同时支配 experiment、learn the rules 和 learn to interact 三个并列谓语。learn the rules 不是状语从句；to interact 是第二个 learn 的不定式补语，through play 说明学习互动的途径。

sentences.text: Lev Vygotsky agrees that play is pivotal for children's development, since they make meaning of their environment through playing educational games.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: that play is pivotal for children's development, since they make meaning of their environment through playing educational games
since they make meaning of their environment through playing educational games

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Lev Vygotsky agrees that ...，that 引导宾语从句。since 在这里表示原因而非“自从”；they 与 their 指儿童，through playing ... 表示他们理解环境的方式。

sentences.text: For Vygotsky, however, play is the first form of learning language and communication, and the stage where a child begins to understand rules and symbols.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: the first form of learning language and communication, and the stage where a child begins to understand rules and symbols

relativeClauses.text: where a child begins to understand rules and symbols

sentences.readingHintZh: For Vygotsky 交代观点归属，however 提示转折。play is 后有两个并列表语：the first form ... 与 the stage ...；where 引导修饰 stage 的定语从句，rules 与 symbols 是 understand 的并列宾语。

sentences.text: This has led to a view that learning in organisms is always related to semiosis, and is often associated with representational systems/activity.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: that learning in organisms is always related to semiosis, and is often associated with representational systems/activity

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 This has led to a view，This 回指前文对游戏的论述。that 从句说明 view 的内容；从句主语 learning 同时对应 is related to 与 is associated with。always 和 often 程度不同，分别限定两种联系。
